description: Paraphrased-query recall fixture from real WatooM homelab incidents. Each query avoids the record's key wording.

records.text: Grafana unified alerting overwrote alertname with the rule title; fixed with label_replace into prom_alert and group_by prom_alert so Discord notifications show the Prometheus alert name.
records.query: why did the Discord notifications all show the same alert name

records.text: node-exporter could not read the textfile collector because the parent directory was created 0700 under umask 077; create each level 0755.
records.query: host metrics missing because exporter lacked permission on the directory

records.text: SQLite backups left -wal and -shm files; set journal_mode=delete on the copy before gzip so the archive is self-contained.
records.query: database backup archive had extra write-ahead log files

records.text: Metasploit database failed to start because the kali data root was mode 0750; set the root to 0751 while subdirectories stay 0750.
records.query: pentest framework database would not start due to folder permissions

records.text: The AgentMemory outbox stranded 1354 uncertain items after ambiguous acknowledgments; reconcile by verified search then requeue absent items to pending.
records.query: memory items stuck and never delivered after timeouts

records.text: The GPU controller refuses to start a model unless nvidia-smi memory.used is below released_gpu_max_mib after the previous model stops.
records.query: switching models fails because video memory still looks occupied

records.text: kube-router network policy: host traffic to ClusterIP services is SNATed to the cni0 address 10.242.0.1, so allow that /32 for probes and host tools.
records.query: node health checks blocked after adding pod firewall rules

records.text: The rig cannot accept inbound connections, so off-host backups use a jailed key-only SFTP pull account and receipts verified against manifests.
records.query: how does the gaming PC get copies of the homelab backups

records.text: Pre-push hook rejects pushes to protected branches; push to dev then fast-forward main in the canonical checkout before pushing to GitHub.
records.query: git refused my push to the feature branch

records.text: A Jinja comment opening with {{# broke template parsing; put the {# #} comment on its own line.
records.query: ansible template failed to parse because of a comment

records.text: llama-server rejects embedding inputs longer than the physical batch with 'input is too large to process'; split into 510-token windows and average.
records.query: embedding request fails for long documents

records.text: The game worker race was caused by concurrent runs; a non-blocking fcntl flock returns early when another run holds the lock.
records.query: two copies of the background job ran at the same time

records.text: Swift Qwen 3.8 runs at 131072 context with q4_0 KV cache, the vision projector on CPU and MTP drafting of four tokens.
records.query: what context length and cache precision does the coding model use

records.text: Cloudflared tunnel tokens are owned 65532:65532 with mode 0400 and RouterOS backups are root 0600 via secure-sensitive-files.
records.query: locking down the tunnel credentials on disk

records.text: Stale Failed pods remained after node pressure eviction; delete them only after confirming no controller still references them.
records.query: evicted pods left behind in error state

records.text: Agent permissions use last-match-wins evaluation, so a later allow rule overrides an earlier deny for the same tool.
records.query: why could the agent still use a tool I had denied

records.text: A nested volumeMount at /state/config shadowed the parent mount; mount the config volume separately read-only.
records.query: files disappeared inside the container because of overlapping mounts

records.text: The release ledger records image digest, OCI revision label and IaC commit so verify-iac proves the running image equals the reviewed commit.
records.query: how do we prove which source commit is running in production

records.text: The rig async completion outbox looped because enqueue conflicted on body text; conflict only on application or session.
records.query: completion notifications kept repeating for the same request

records.text: BGE small v1.5 on llama.cpp used 307 MiB VRAM idle beside Swift; the controller threshold stays satisfied.
records.query: how much graphics memory does the embedding model take
